question: What alignment is prescribed for the āliṅga architectural member?
premises: The āliṅga is the element under consideration.
It is declared to be equal to the outer line of the foot.
This alignment is approved by the text.
inference: The āliṅga should be set equal to the outer boundary of the foot.
uncertainties: The exact technical identity of āliṅga here is context-dependent.
plain_english: The āliṅga is declared to be equal to the outer line of the foot and is approved.
